title: DIA Routing Slip and Report to the Joint Chiefs of Staff: Reported UFO Sighting, September 23, 1976
doc_notes: This is a DIA routing slip and intelligence report regarding a 1976 UFO sighting in Iran, which contains detailed encounter information.

encounters.summary: Multiple witnesses in Tehran reported strange objects in the sky, leading to the scramble of two F-4 aircraft. One pilot reported loss of instrumentation and communication when approaching the object, while a second pilot reported a radar lock and observed a smaller object detach from the main craft.
encounters.entity_appearance: Bright star-like object with flashing strobe lights in a rectangular pattern, alternating blue, green, red, and orange.
encounters.quote: The object and the pursuing F-4 continued on a course to the south of Tehran
